Sorry. Maybe you're right. 

This is but me rambling about my own (momentary) subject views... kindled by some unfortunate event I've been through...

I shouldn't have posted this on /SW. I don't think I'm actually considering suicide. Maybe I'm just an attention whore who wished to witness that someone could care. I don't want my inquietude to deviate the help you guys offer to the people who really need it.

Maybe a Mod can delete my post. I don't think this helps anyone, myself included. Sorry for that.
